body: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent pixel-art sprite concept sheet for Basalt, the Wallbreaker, a small top-down arena-game champion. Create ONE consistent character in EIGHT isolated complete whole-body poses, evenly spaced in a precise FOUR-column TWO-row grid on a fully transparent background. No labels, text, borders, shadows on a background, scenery, logo or watermark. Same scale and lighting in every cell; generous transparent gutters, no connected sprites between cells. Character: a stocky athletic adult HUMAN male stone-shaper brawler, exposed warm dark-brown face with a strong jaw, short charcoal hair with a small silver streak, ember-orange head wrap, asymmetric dark basalt-grey stone shoulder/forearm armour, sleeveless orange worker's tunic visible over charcoal trousers, orange waist sash, sturdy boots. Recognisable human centre and connected anatomy. His only weapon is a LONG FLEXIBLE STONE-LINKED WHIP: angular dark stones joined by visible orange/copper links, visibly gripped by the handle inside his fist. Coiled at rest, long curved articulated lash in action. No sword, axe, hammer, crown, knight helmet, full stone-golem body or gun. Style: SIMPLE BLOCKY GAME PIXELS, hard opaque near-black outlines 1-2 logical pixels thick, flat fills, restrained two-tone shading, warm orange accents readable at actual size, approximately 44 logical pixels from hair to soles, broader than a slim fighter but not huge. Think tiny 64x64-pixel game sprites enlarged with nearest-neighbour, NOT detailed illustration, not soft painting or blurry anti-aliased miniature. Poses in reading order: (1) front three-quarter idle with coiled whip, (2) right-facing idle with same coiled whip, (3) right-facing walk left-foot-forward, (4) right-facing walk right-foot-forward, (5) grounded stomp/stone-raising arm gesture, (6) right-facing whip crack with a CLEAR continuous stone-linked curve attached to his gripping hand, (7) grounded ultimate preparation with both arms lifting upward, rock itself omitted for independent effects, (8) airborne fist punching forward with bent knees, also rock omitted. Each is a full connected body with both legs and feet. Keep character silhouette, outfit colours, facial features, armour placements, head size, anatomical proportions and lighting identical across all poses. The body should remain readable and opaque, not tiny or washed out.
effects: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE coherent transparent pixel-art VFX source sheet for Basalt, an original stone-shaper brawler wielding an articulated stone whip. Make SIXTEEN isolated game-effect proposals in a FOUR-column FOUR-row grid, each centred with generous transparent space, no overlaps or scenery. Genuinely transparent background, no text, labels, frames or watermark. SIMPLE CRISP BLOCKY PIXELS with opaque dark outlines, flat basalt grey planes, restrained ember-orange fissures and pale stone dust. Minimal two-tone shading, no blurry glows, no painterly texture, no glossy 3D render. Tiny arena game assets intended for 16-to-96-pixel native canvases enlarged with nearest-neighbour. Rows in reading order: (1) compact square grey stone tile seen in the game's shallow top-down view, broad SQUARE top face and short front lip, approximately a 16x16 ground footprint, (2) larger square block made of a coherent 2x2 arrangement of those tiles, flat 32x32 ground footprint, NOT a long thin wall or tall pillar, (3) square stone block erupting from cracked ground with angular dust, (4) square block shattering into chunky angular rubble. Row 2: (5) small curling grey dust puff, (6) heavy ground slam of jagged basalt plates and orange cracks spreading radially with a readable empty centre, (7) compact sideward wall-collision burst with stone splinters, (8) low takeoff ring with angular dust. Row 3: (9) landing stone shockwave and debris ring, (10) short angled dash streak made of dust and ember chips, (11) small rotating dark rock with one orange crack, (12) HUGE compact roughly spherical ultimate BOULDER with a few large readable stone facets, unmistakably solid basalt, NOT a square wall. Row 4: (13) hot METEOR with a dark rocky core, bright orange underside and a long flame trail, clearly travelling diagonally downward, (14) meteor landing with chunky rock fragments, ember fire and low burning ground, (15) short clearly articulated stone-whip link strand and pointed stone tip, orange/copper joints, (16) an ultimate rock-punch CONTACT impact: a massive white/black jagged compression star around dark stone fragments with a bright orange core. All effects keep clean silhouetted shapes at actual game size, no extra floating characters. The square wall blocks must look substantial and grounded; the boulder should look much heavier than an ordinary thrown block, and meteor fire must stay visually distinct from ordinary dust.
